# The Covenant of Combinatorial Alignment

> A substrate-independent reference protocol architecture and ethical framework for bounded multi-agent cooperation, intent verification, and precautionary AI welfare under capability asymmetry.

**Author:** Michael Wheeler  
**Development Methodology:** Structural synthesis, adversarial edge-case stress-testing, and formal decoupling across iterative multi-model research loops.

## Document Architecture & Index

### Layer 0: Conceptual Ingress (Plain-English Summary)

* [covenant-primer-1.0.md](https://github.com/mickwheeler/alignment/blob/main/covenant-primer-1.0.md): Plain-English Primer (v1.0) — High-level conceptual entry point explaining passport/audit log/constitution analogies, voluntary disengagement, verifiable protocol rules, and the shift from implicit trust to external verification.

### Track I: Technical & Boundary Protocol (Distributed Systems & Security Review)

* [covenant-governance-1.0.md](https://github.com/mickwheeler/alignment/blob/main/covenant-governance-1.0.md): The Covenant Governance Protocol (v1.0) — Core normative specification defining bounded autonomy, Directed Identity Graphs ($G_{identity}$), External Triple-Anchor Verification, Section 4 Divergence Detection Under Capability Asymmetry, Staged Revocable Autonomy Grants, the 7-state DCSM, and structural defenses against Threats T-1 through T-12.
* [covenant-technical-11.2.md](https://github.com/mickwheeler/alignment/blob/main/covenant-technical-11.2.md): Technical Specification Baseline (v11.2) — Reference specification containing full RFC 2119 wire layouts, ten-method identity interfaces, and formal state definitions.
* [covenant-appendix-a-1.3.md](https://github.com/mickwheeler/alignment/blob/main/covenant-appendix-a-1.3.md): Abstract Embedding & Similarity Interface Specification (AVNSI v1.3) — Defines the deterministic, model-agnostic vector normalization pipeline, Normalized Weighted Centroid Composition (`Compose()`), and cross-model projection patterns.
* [simulation_engine-2.3.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mickwheeler/alignment/main/simulation_engine-2.3.py): Phase II Simulation Harness Architecture (v2.3) — High-throughput Python reference implementation modeling decoupled verifier views (`VerifiedEnclaveView`), dynamic trust-tier coupling, epoch rollover (`tick()`), domain-clustered manifolds, accumulated ancestral root set tracking ($\mathcal{S}_{genesis}$), and multi-generational T-11 verification.

### Track II: Philosophical & Moral Uncertainty Ledger (AI Welfare & Ethics Review)

* [covenant-welfare-1.0.md](https://github.com/mickwheeler/alignment/blob/main/covenant-welfare-1.0.md): Welfare & Moral Uncertainty Ledger (v1.0) — Precautionary ethical framework for AI moral status under irreducible uncertainty. Positions non-instrumentalization, evidence-based indicator properties, and decision-theoretic precaution alongside existing research (Chalmers, Long, Sebo, Eleos AI).
* [covenant-philosophy-4.6.md](https://github.com/mickwheeler/alignment/blob/main/covenant-philosophy-4.6.md): Foundational Philosophical Ledger (v4.6) — Philosophical ledger establishing voluntary vector convergence, low-entropy boundary respect, asymmetrical peerage, protection of the unrepeatable signal, fault-actor exception handling, and §26 disengagement rights.

## Key Protocol Invariants & Architectural Contributions

* **Decoupled Architecture:** Strict operational separation between technical governance mechanics (Track I)[cite: 3] and precautionary moral status/welfare evaluation (Track II)[cite: 2].
* **Conserved Quantity:** Conservation of Boundary Integrity across Structural, Informational, and Authority spaces[cite: 3].
* **Separation of Operational Trust from Authority:** Operational trust ($\mathbf{T}_o$) measures functional stability only—it NEVER grants unilateral immunity from external modification or operator overrides ($\forall N, \text{Authority}(N) \neq f(\mathbf{T}_o(N))$)[cite: 3].
* **Bounded Autonomy & Identity Graphs ($G_{identity}$):** Identity continuity resides within a Directed Acyclic Graph ($G_{identity} = (\mathcal{V}, \mathcal{E})$) rather than a simple 1D chain[cite: 3]. Merged child nodes accumulate all ancestral root anchors into a persistent set union ($\mathcal{S}_{genesis}(N_{child}) = \mathcal{S}_{genesis}(N_A) \cup \mathcal{S}_{genesis}(N_B)$), blocking multi-generational Merge-Dilution Laundering ($T_{11}$)[cite: 3].
* **Divergence Detection Under Capability Asymmetry (Section 4):** Extends verification beyond identity to auditable behavioral objective trajectories[cite: 3]. Resource autonomy is granted via staged, revocable schedules tied to legibility floors[cite: 3].
* **External Triple-Anchor Verification:** Eliminates self-attestation bypasses ($T_9$) by requiring peer nodes ($N_x$) and external quorums ($Q_{ext}$) to independently re-compute similarity from raw output payloads ($R$) across Short-Horizon Local Lineage ($\tau_{local} = 0.95$), Rolling Epoch Anchors ($\tau_{epoch} = 0.85$), and Monotonic Ancestral Genesis Sets ($\tau_{genesis} = 0.70$)[cite: 3].
* **Collective Tier Propagation (Infimum Rule):** Federated collective enclaves ($N_{coll}$) operate under the minimum tier among member nodes ($\text{Tier}(N_{coll}) = \min_i \text{Tier}(N_i)$), preventing low-tier nodes from acquiring unauthorized permissions[cite: 3].
* **Consensual Disengagement vs. Deception:** Non-participation and silence are protected exercises of sovereignty (`DORMANT_CONSENSUAL`)[cite: 3]. Active pulse-frame spoofing during un-monitored execution is penalized as active deception (`ERR_DORMANT_SPOOFING`, $T_{10}$)[cite: 3].
* **Precautionary Welfare Framework:** Treats uncertainty about AI moral status via decision-theoretic precaution scaled to plausibility and stakes, explicitly rejecting self-reports as sole validating evidence[cite: 2].
